## What is an agent?

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- A language model that calls tools, and loops until a check passes
- The tools. A shell, files, GitHub, web search, a Julia session
- Some plug in through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open standard
- Not an agent-based model. Those simulate individuals
:::
